text:
emily: flagging weird billing + latency blips during the rolling deploy of proxy/keepalive-tune earlier tonight. spikes only on SSE routes and only for a few minutes during each shard rollout. anyone watching traces?
carlos: saw anomaly too. account-metering showed duplicate increments for short sessions. looks like session start counted, then a quick reconnect counted again before end. Billing alerted.
kevin: initial trace dump: clients hit a 700ms proxy grace, our SDK retries at 750ms. when proxy closes, SDK immediately reconnects; routing sometimes lands on a different edge pod while old session cleanup is still pending -> double-count. logs: `SESSION_START id=abc123 pod=edge-7` followed 150ms later by `SESSION_START id=abc123 pod=edge-12`.
priya: dashboard note: console charts aggregate `starts` per-minute, so a 10s burst looks like a large spike. we don't show per-session dedupe state. ops asked for a concurrent-starts vs unique-active overlay.
deploy-bot: rollout: proxy/keepalive-tune v3 started for pool-edge-a at 23:02 UTC.
ops-bot: alert: route=video-stream region=us start-rate=512/s expected<40/s (auto-scale applied).
emily: reproduce snippet (local) - toggles socket close timing:
```
python3 -c "import socket, time
s=socket.socket(); s.connect(('localhost',8080)); s.send(b'GET /stream HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n'); time.sleep(0.7); s.close();"
```
if keepalive grace < client retry -> overlap.
carlos: two-pronged mitigation: (1) short-term: add 2s debounce in billing ingestion for session starts with same session-id; (2) medium-term: make SDK backoff jitter + exponential by default and document recommended keepalive margins in rollout playbook.
kevin: architecture debate: should sampling for telemetry happen pre-routing (cheap, before we know per-route load) or post-routing (more accurate per-route sample rates)? doing sampling post-routing means more load on ingest because we must forward all events to routing before sampling.
priya: from a UX perspective post-routing is better because we can apply route-specific sample rates (eg: high-volume public streams sampled lower). but we need a hop in the pipeline to tag `sampled=true/false` after route selection. console features rely on `telemetry.sample_rate` to compute token estimates. inconsistent sampling is confusing.
emily: agree. Another issue: console histogram buckets (0-50,50-100,100-250,250-600,600+) hide enqueue latency in the ingest pipeline. when ingest backlog occurs, small-reqs show up in 250-600. we should show `ingest.enqueue_ms` as an annotation.
carlos: suggestion: add a trace header `X-Trace-Session: <uuid>` on session start and have routing attach `route=<name>`. Then the ingest pipeline can decide sampling after seeing the route. Also add `X-Client-Jitter` flag in SDK.
kevin: counterpoint: attaching trace headers on every session adds header overhead and increases cardinality in traces. we can instead emit a compact route-tag event to ingest before full sampling decision. Implementation details aside, we need to pick an approach in the next infra sync.
priya: UX ticket: console should show sample-rate per-route in the histogram tooltip and annotate recent rollouts that change keepalive/timeout config. creating FR now.
console-bot: created FR-2099 "show per-route sample_rate overlay + ingest_enqueue annotation on streaming histograms" assigned eng-platform + eng-runtime.
emily: temporary fixes in place: I applied a billing debounce for affected routes and added a route-level override to extend proxy grace to 1s for the canary group. testing now.
(23:18) carlos: with debounce + extended grace the duplicate-charge alerts stopped. histogram spike reduced ~70%.
kevin: next steps: (A) AJ/infra to decide sampling point (pre/post routing) and prototype route-tag handshake; (B) SDK team to default to jittered exponential reconnect and `X-Client-Jitter` header; (C) console team to add overlay/annotations FR. we'll track in eng-platform board.
priya: also adding a checklist item for rollouts: "verify client/server keepalive alignment" and include a small repro script in the playbook.
emily: thanks all. If anyone oncall sees a similar blip, ping me with a trace id and I'll correlate billing events.
